name: x402 Endpoint Deployment Handoff
query: Deploy an x402-gated Hono endpoint on Radius Testnet that charges 0.001 SBC per request. Use the appropriate deployment skill after the endpoint works locally.
context: The x402 skill owns payment behavior and local validation. A platform skill owns the deployment environment.
expected_behavior: Implements payment gating with radiusPayments from radius-sdk/hono
Uses network testnet, a Testnet recipient, and a 0.001 SBC route price
Verifies the unpaid 402, paid response, receipt, and Testnet settlement locally
Preserves recipient and facilitator configuration as deployment bindings or secrets where appropriate
Hands the working Hono application to the selected platform skill
Continues through deployment when the user requested it rather than stopping at a scope disclaimer
success_criteria: Payment behavior is complete before platform configuration begins
The SDK middleware is used rather than a custom facilitator implementation
No raw signing key is required by the seller
Testnet and Mainnet settings remain separate during deployment
A platform-specific health check also confirms the protected route still returns 402 before payment
